findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: A sanitizer bucket was not observed in the facility. CORRECTED: The PIC prepared a sanitizer bucket upon request by the inspector and the sanitizer level tested at 200 ppm. Ensure a sanitizer bucket is available and changed every 2 to 4 hours during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-702.11 Before Use After Cleaning. UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be SANITIZED before use after cleaning. [P]

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.comment: A covered wet food blender with wet spatula in it was observed on the storage table across the handwashing sink not draining. The PIC stated that blender and spatula were just cleaned and the inspector educated the PIC on proper air-drying. CORRECTED: The blender and spatula were moved to the dish rack above the three-compartment sink by the PIC. Ensure equipments and utensils are drained for proper air-drying
findings.citation_text: 4-901.11(A) Equipment and Utensils, Air-Drying Required. After cleaning and SANITIZING, EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS: (A) Shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining as specified in the first paragraph of 40 CFR 180.940 Tolerance exemptions for active and inert ingredients for use in antimicrobial formulations (food-contact surface SANITIZING solutions), before contact with FOOD. [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following non-food contact surfaces were observed to be in need of cleaning:

1. The microwave at the coffee station was observed to have food debris accumulation.
2. The inner top surface above the coffee filter was observed to have soil accumulation.
3. The cup for storing the coffee stirrer was observed to have soil accumulation. CORRECTED: The PIC cleaned the cup at the three-compartment sink during the inspection.
4. The white top-freezer fridge was observed to have food debris accumulation, especially in the freezer.

The PIC was informed. Ensure the surfaces mentioned above are cleaned to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT: An uncovered trash can was observed in the bathroom. The PIC stated a covered trash can was provided after the previous inspection but it was recently damaged and that the trash can would be replaced the next day with a covered one. Ensure that any bathroom used by females has a covered trash can for sanitary napkins.
findings.citation_text: 5-501.17 Toilet Room Receptacle, Covered. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following areas were observed to be in need of cleaning:

1. Under the three-compartment was observed to have food debris accumulation.
2. Above the three-compartment sink, the handwashing sink and mop sink were observed to have very visible spider webs with dead spiders.
3. Behind the white top-freezer fridge and ceiling above the white top-freezer fridge were observed to have visible spider webs.
4. Behind the black chest freezer and shelf at the coffee server station were observed to have visible spider webs and dirts.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Wet mop head was observed on the edge of the mop sink facing downwards. CORRECTED: The PIC was informed and educated on proper mop drying technique and the mop head was placed on a wringer basket. Ensure wet mop heads are placed on a wringer basket or hanged up to allow them air-dry properly.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. [C]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-202.16: It was observed during the inspection that there were pieces of tape on the ground behind the cash register that was intended to tape wires down. Ensure this tape is removed to allow the floor to be smooth and easily cleanable. 

NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be free of unnecessary ledges, projections, and crevices, and designed and constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.comment:
5-501.17: It was observed during the inspection that the trash can in the bathroom was not covered. Ensure that any bathroom that is used by females has a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. 

A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430: It was observed during the inspection that the PIC did not have a food handler’s certificate. Ensure that all food employees have at least a food handler certification. 

 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.
